visual_thesis: A read-only operation can use a qualified alternate provider only within replay, time and policy boundaries; ambiguous actions need reconciliation.
mechanism_metaphor: A routing junction with a visible multi-condition eligibility sieve and a separate reconciliation siding
story_anchors: Replayable read-only inference differs from stateful workflow recovery
Secondary route needs compatible features, data controls, capacity and time

source_claim_map.proposition: Replayable read-only inference differs from stateful workflow recovery
source_claim_map.supporting_source_excerpt: OpenAI’s production-routing guide separates multi-provider availability from safe workflow recovery. Using a read-only fraud assessment, it permits failover only when retries are repeatable, deadlines remain, the secondary is approved and healthy, and features plus data controls match. Stateful sessions, partial outputs, unknown errors and uncertain actions require reconciliation or a safe stop.

visual_thesis: A common chat base combines decision and guardian adapters with a colocated speech encoder; activated adapters can reuse the base KV cache.
mechanism_metaphor: An open layered checkpoint specimen with nested adapters, speech inlet and exposed shared cache
story_anchors: Decision and guardian are activated adapters
Speech encoder is colocated and base KV cache is reused

source_claim_map.proposition: Decision and guardian are activated adapters
source_claim_map.supporting_source_excerpt: IBM Granite’s 8B and 30B Switch 4.1 checkpoints combine a general decision adapter, a guardian adapter and a speech encoder with the base chat model. Activated LoRAs reuse the base model’s KV cache, while the project supports vLLM and llama.cpp. Reported speed and benchmark claims remain publisher-produced and need workload-specific replication.

visual_thesis: Reliable enterprise context requires a continuously maintained five-stage knowledge lifecycle, beyond storage and retrieval.
mechanism_metaphor: Five linked knowledge terraces carrying an identifiable knowledge specimen with governance rails
story_anchors: Five stages capture validate organize govern deliver
Knowledge nodes retain provenance and ownership; decayed trust triggers expert revalidation

source_claim_map.proposition: Five stages capture validate organize govern deliver
source_claim_map.supporting_source_excerpt: Stack Overflow divides an enterprise AI context layer into capture, validation, organization, governance and delivery. Its argument is that connectors and retrieval are only the beginning: teams must preserve provenance, ownership, permissions, audit history and changing trust. The article promotes Stack Internal, so its build-versus-buy conclusion should be tested against internal costs and alternatives.

visual_thesis: Readers need visible process constraints to interpret independent AI-risk findings; transparency supports scrutiny without certifying deployment safety.
mechanism_metaphor: A fanned open report with translucent process lenses and a protected confidential side compartment
story_anchors: Disclose access, scope and redactions alongside findings
Public methods and uncertainty support external scrutiny while confidentiality remains bounded

source_claim_map.proposition: Disclose access, scope and redactions alongside findings
source_claim_map.supporting_source_excerpt: METR explains how external AI-risk work can inform the public without pretending to certify deployment decisions. It commits to disclose project scope, access limits, redactions, constraints and conflicts, while protecting confidential material. The organization also aims to publish evidence and methods for outside analysis, acknowledge scientific uncertainty and issue iterative findings rather than closed-door assurance.

visual_thesis: Five context-management mechanisms keep active context focused while preserving recoverable raw records and user-controlled persistent memory.
mechanism_metaphor: A compact context well surrounded by five distinct storage and work compartments with selective retrieval paths
story_anchors: Offloading stores raw output and supplies a preview
Summarization preserves recoverable history; file memory survives provider changes

source_claim_map.proposition: Offloading stores raw output and supplies a preview
source_claim_map.supporting_source_excerpt: LangChain describes five Deep Agents mechanisms for limiting context rot: offload large inputs to files, summarize older turns, load skills only when relevant, isolate noisy work in subagents and persist selected knowledge as plain Markdown. Summaries remain recoverable, and user-controlled storage lets memory survive a model or provider change instead of remaining trapped in one service.

visual_thesis: A portable release-note procedure drafts and compares outputs under explicit permissions; publishing remains behind human approval.
mechanism_metaphor: An orthogonal permission lattice opening onto a read-only evidence bench that terminates before publication
story_anchors: Named SKILL.md procedure discovered from supported paths
Allow ask deny skill rules and manual selection bound the release-note procedure

source_claim_map.proposition: Named SKILL.md procedure discovered from supported paths
source_claim_map.supporting_source_excerpt: OpenCode documents portable SKILL.md discovery across project, global, Claude-compatible and agent-compatible paths. Its git-release example pairs strict frontmatter with bounded instructions for drafting release notes, proposing a version bump and returning a copyable command. Pattern permissions can allow, deny or require approval, while manual-only metadata prevents accidental automatic selection.
